title: History-consistent opponent-hole posterior support smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Frozen greedy opponent action histories retain enough exact opponent-hole support across both seats and all streets to enable posterior-marginalized counterfactual targets.
material_change: Enumerate and replay all opponent-hole pairs for 64 balanced exact-v6 decision states under each frozen opponent observation contract; test support before any value target or weight update.
source: Standard10 plus four frozen mixed-contract trajectory opponents

notes: All 69,296 enumerated hole candidates were evaluated under frozen exact observation contracts; accepted support is preserved per row.

result.summary: Exact deterministic opponent-history filtering completed 64 balanced states from 112 trajectory hands and enumerated 69,296 candidate hole pairs. Every true trajectory hole remained in support, all accepted replays reproduced public/financial state, minimum support was 149 and median support 772; every preregistered support gate passed.
result.conclusion: The fixed-hole hindsight failure has a viable data remedy: frozen greedy action histories leave ample history-consistent opponent-hole support even under mixed legacy/native opponent contracts. This establishes posterior feasibility only; it does not validate action values or a policy. The next reliability run must sample disjoint development/confirmation holes from these supports and independently resample future boards before any learned update.
result.next_step: Freeze this posterior artifact and run one separately logged 8+8 posterior-hole/future-runout all-legal target reliability smoke on the same 64 rows. Train nothing unless action identity, confirmation value, every-stratum, and new-all-in gates all pass.
